# States Logistics Services, Inc.

States Logistics Services, Inc. is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. States Logistics is a premier 3PL warehousing and distribution provider for transportation, packaging, and freight consolidation in California and Arizona. States Logistics Services, Inc. employs 257 people (+4.5% YoY, +11 people) and has an annual revenue of $65M, founded in 1958. Headquartered in Buena Park, California, United States, with offices in Fontana, Tolleson, and Ontario. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Peru.

## About

Since 1958, States Logistics Services has been a trusted partner for cost effective and value driven third-party logistics (3PL) and supply chain management solutions. Our comprehensive suite of logistics services in Arizona and California, include warehousing, transportation, contract packaging, freight consolidation, and value-added services. We pride ourselves on elevating and streamlining our clients’ supply chains. With operations in Southern California and Arizona, States Logistics has become the premier 3PL provider on the west coast. 

Service Areas: Southern California and Phoenix, Arizona Specialties: Supply chain optimization, warehousing, contract packaging, transportation, freight brokerage, and multi-vendor freight consolidation.
